userStories.title: Add confidence adjustment compounding guard to prevent cascading false negatives
acceptanceCriteria: apply_all_adjustments() in scoring.py tracks cumulative negative adjustment magnitude across all 15+ adjustments
When cumulative negative adjustments exceed configurable threshold (default -0.30), remaining negative adjustments are dampened by 50%
New 'adjustment_compounding' entry added to confidence_breakdown showing total negative sum and whether dampening was applied
Config field matching.scoring.max_cumulative_negative_adjustment (float, default -0.30) added to MatchingScoringConfig
Unit test verifies dampening activates when 5+ negative adjustments compound past threshold
Unit test verifies dampening does NOT activate when total negative adjustment is within threshold
userStories.notes: Tier: unit-testable scoring logic. Files: src/matching/scoring.py (apply_all_adjustments ~line 3702, add tracking after each adjustment call), src/config/sections/matching.py (MatchingScoringConfig ~line 105, add max_cumulative_negative_adjustment field), config.yaml (matching.scoring section). Implemented: compounding guard tracks cumulative negative adjustments via _apply_compounding_guard() closure, dampens by 50% past -0.30 threshold, adds adjustment_compounding breakdown entry. 6 unit tests all pass.

userStories.title: Add adaptive candidate pool sizing based on voiceover segment complexity
acceptanceCriteria: EmbeddingSearch.search() calculates complexity_score from segment word count, entity presence, and location words
Candidate pool size (k) scales: base_k * (1.0 + 0.5 * complexity_score) with configurable min_k=15 and max_k=100
Simple segments (<=5 words, no entities) get expanded pool; complex specific segments get standard pool
Config fields min_candidates, max_candidates, and complexity_scaling_factor added to EmbeddingSearchConfig
Unit test verifies pool expansion for short generic segment ('the city') vs specific segment ('historic architecture of Dubrovnik')
userStories.notes: Tier: unit-testable search logic. Files: src/matching/embedding_search.py (search() ~line 93, add complexity calculation before FAISS query; _compute_complexity_score() new method), src/config/sections/matching.py (EmbeddingSearchConfig ~line 23, add min_candidates/max_candidates/complexity_scaling_factor). Currently embedding_candidates is static at 20. Short generic voiceover needs broader search (50+) while specific voiceover with entities needs fewer but more precise candidates.

userStories.title: Add source stutter penalty to prevent A-B-A video alternation pattern
acceptanceCriteria: apply_temporal_coherence_penalty() detects A-B-A pattern where current source matches 2-segments-ago but differs from previous
Stutter penalty of configurable magnitude (default -0.04) applied when pattern detected
Penalty added to confidence_breakdown as 'source_stutter_penalty' entry with reason showing the A-B-A source IDs
Config field matching.scoring.source_stutter_penalty (float, default 0.04) added to MatchingScoringConfig
Unit test verifies penalty applied for A-B-A pattern but NOT for A-A-A (continuation) or A-B-C (progression)
userStories.notes: Tier: unit-testable scoring logic. Files: src/matching/scoring.py (apply_temporal_coherence_penalty ~line 727, add prev_prev_source tracking; need access to match history 2 segments back), src/config/sections/matching.py (MatchingScoringConfig, add source_stutter_penalty field). Problem: segment 10=videoA, 11=videoB, 12=videoA creates jarring visual stutter. Temporal coherence currently only checks previous segment, missing the A-B-A ping-pong pattern.

userStories.title: Add pre-fetch diversity filter to FAISS candidate retrieval
acceptanceCriteria: EmbeddingSearch._compute_similarity() fetches k*2 candidates from FAISS, then applies source diversity filter to return k diverse results
Source concentration ratio (unique_sources / total_candidates) logged for each search
When concentration ratio < 0.3 (less than 30% unique sources in raw results), a warning is logged
Config field pre_fetch_multiplier (int, default 2) added to EmbeddingSearchConfig
Unit test verifies diverse results when top-20 FAISS results are dominated by 2 sources (10 each)
userStories.notes: Tier: unit-testable search logic. Files: src/matching/embedding_search.py (_compute_similarity ~line 223, change k to k*multiplier; _deduplicate_by_source ~line 188 already exists but runs after retrieval — move earlier or add pre-filter), src/config/sections/matching.py (EmbeddingSearchConfig, add pre_fetch_multiplier). Problem: max_candidates_per_source=3 is applied AFTER FAISS retrieval. If top 20 are from 2 videos (10 each), we fetch 20 then truncate to 6, wasting computation and missing diverse candidates ranked 21-40.

userStories.title: Apply confidence penalty when LLM reranker produces low-quality reasoning
acceptanceCriteria: When is_low_quality_reasoning() returns True in llm_providers.py, a -0.05 confidence penalty is applied to the match
Match metadata includes 'llm_reasoning_quality' field (0=low, 1=normal) for downstream analysis
When secondary LLM fallback is triggered (confidence < ambiguous_threshold), an additional 0.9x multiplier is applied
Both penalties appear in confidence_breakdown as 'llm_reasoning_penalty' and 'secondary_llm_decay' entries
Unit test verifies penalty applied for generic reasoning ('this matches because it is relevant') vs specific reasoning
userStories.notes: Tier: unit-testable scoring/reranking logic. Files: src/matching/llm_reranker.py (lines 133-156, add penalty after primary/secondary LLM calls), src/matching/llm_providers.py (is_low_quality_reasoning ~line 165, already detects but doesn't act), src/matching/scoring.py (apply_all_adjustments, add llm_reasoning_penalty step). Problem: is_low_quality_reasoning() logs warnings but takes no corrective action. If LLM says 'this video matches because it shows relevant content', the confidence score is unreliable and should be discounted.

userStories.title: Add smooth duration ratio reward curve replacing step-function penalties
acceptanceCriteria: Duration ratio scoring uses smooth curve: near-perfect ratio (0.9-1.1x) gets +0.02 boost instead of zero adjustment
Penalty curve uses logarithmic scaling: penalty = min(0.10, 0.02 * abs(log2(ratio))) for ratios outside 0.5-2.0 range
Existing step thresholds (ratio<0.3 and ratio>3.0) remain as hard floor/ceiling penalties
Config fields duration_ratio_reward_threshold (default 0.1) and duration_ratio_reward_boost (default 0.02) added
Unit test verifies graduated penalties: ratio 0.4 gets less penalty than ratio 0.2; ratio 0.95 gets boost
userStories.notes: Tier: unit-testable scoring math. Files: src/matching/scoring.py (apply_duration_penalty ~line 136, replace step-function with smooth curve while keeping existing hard thresholds as boundaries), src/config/sections/matching.py (MatchingScoringConfig, add duration_ratio_reward_threshold and duration_ratio_reward_boost). Problem: current 3-band system treats 0.4x same as 0.9x (both get zero adjustment). Misses opportunity to boost near-perfect duration matches and penalize proportionally.

userStories.title: Add ambiguous pool detection and flagging when candidate variance is below threshold
acceptanceCriteria: When top-10 candidate similarity scores have variance < 0.02, match is flagged as 'ambiguous_pool' in match metadata
Warning logged: 'Top N candidates within X range — match selection may be arbitrary'
Quality report includes 'uncertain_matches_count' tracking how many segments had ambiguous pools
Config field variance_warning_threshold (float, default 0.02) added to MatchingScoringConfig
Unit test verifies flag set when 10 candidates all score 0.87-0.89 and NOT set when clear winner exists (0.95 vs 0.70s)
userStories.notes: Tier: unit-testable search/scoring logic. Files: src/matching/scoring.py (calculate_adaptive_threshold ~line 51, variance floor already at 0.02 but doesn't flag), src/matching/embedding_search.py (search() ~line 93, add variance check after similarity computation), src/matching/metrics.py (add uncertain_matches_count to quality report). Problem: variance floor (0.02) silently prevents threshold reduction when all candidates score nearly identically. Low variance from 20 candidates scoring 0.87-0.89 suggests weak embedding signal, not a clear winner — this should be surfaced to the user.

userStories.title: Add inter-track embedding distance metric for alternative selection diversity
acceptanceCriteria: After alternative selection, compute pairwise embedding cosine distance between V1, V2, V3 for each segment
Track-level diversity score calculated as mean pairwise distance across all segments
Warning logged when avg_embedding_distance(V1, V2, V3) < configurable threshold (default 0.15)
Quality report includes 'track_diversity_score' and 'low_diversity_segments_count'
Unit test verifies low diversity detected when V1-V3 are all cityscape variants vs high diversity with different scene types
userStories.notes: Tier: unit-testable selection/metrics logic. Files: src/matching/alternative_selection.py (after select_alternatives, add diversity computation), src/matching/metrics.py (add track_diversity_score and low_diversity_segments_count to quality report), src/config/sections/matching.py (add min_track_diversity_distance to config). Problem: V2-V3 alternatives prefer different sources, but no metric tracks HOW different. V1='cityscape day', V2='cityscape sunset', V3='cityscape aerial' are different sources but provide low real editorial diversity.

userStories.title: Add actionable diagnostics to match quality trend degradation detection
acceptanceCriteria: MatchQualityTrend adds per-chunk diagnostics: avg_confidence, avg_candidates_considered, dominant_negative_adjustment for each chunk
When trend is DEGRADING, a cause summary string is generated identifying the top adjustment causing decline
Cause summary format: 'Degradation in chunks 8-10 due to: 60% of negative adjustments were chapter_coherence_penalty'
Quality report includes 'trend_diagnostics' array with chunk-level detail when trend is DEGRADING
Unit test verifies correct cause identification when degradation is driven by a single dominant penalty type
userStories.notes: Tier: unit-testable metrics/reporting logic. Files: src/matching/metrics.py (MatchQualityTrend class ~line 501, add chunk_diagnostics dict to each trend chunk; add cause identification logic ~line 737), src/config/sections/matching.py (no config needed — purely reporting). Problem: current trend detection logs 'DEGRADING' or 'IMPROVING' but provides no actionable insight. Knowing quality degraded in the last 30% is useless without WHY — was it fewer candidates? worse embeddings? chapter mismatch?

userStories.title: Propagate video_chapters and video_tags fields to DownloadedVideo dataclass
acceptanceCriteria: DownloadedVideo in state.py has video_chapters: List[dict] and video_tags: List[str] fields with default empty list
VideoSearchResult-to-DownloadedVideo conversion preserves video_chapters and video_tags
Checkpoint serialization/deserialization round-trips video_chapters and video_tags on DownloadedVideo
Existing DownloadedVideo instances without these fields deserialize cleanly (backward compat via field defaults)
Unit test verifies field propagation from VideoSearchResult through to DownloadedVideo
userStories.notes: Tier: unit-testable data model fix. Files: src/state.py (DownloadedVideo ~line 67, add video_chapters and video_tags fields matching VideoSearchResult's fields at lines 268-269). This is the ONE remaining gap from the metadata extraction feature — VideoSearchResult has these fields but DownloadedVideo does not, meaning chapter/tag metadata is lost when videos are downloaded. Also check src/stages/download_segments_stage.py for the conversion point where VideoSearchResult becomes DownloadedVideo.
